statement: No itinerary of length at most eight is a Juggler cycle itinerary at any n ≥ 2; equivalently a nontrivial Juggler cycle, if one exists, has period at least nine. Assembly: the length-≤7 census, the formal-expansion filter on length eight, the odd-run exclusion of O^7E, Theorem 3.12 at k=8, rotation of EOOOOOOE and OEOOOOOE onto those leftovers, and the internal-E bootstrap exclusions of OOOOEOOE, OOOEOOOE, and OOEOOOOE. Lean theorem no_cycle_itinerary_length_le_eight in LengthEightCensus.lean. Implied by Paper A Corollary 3.23 (period at least eleven). Strengthened by J-small-cycle-census-ten. This is not a length-9 itinerary census and not a halt theorem.
